summary: Full e2e verification of GESOI rename + new CMS features (SEO & Browser section, theme color pickers as CSS vars, Susunan & Tampil sections order/visibility, footer new keys, shared logo/favicon/ogImage). Backend pytest 51/51 PASS. Frontend: 8/8 scenarios PASS after retries (T3 & T6 failed initially due to test-script issues — ElementHandle.blur() unsupported and wrong CSS selector for navbar logo — retried with fixed selectors and passed). Final Reset applied so site_content is empty; landing renders defaults. TEST_ contacts (4) cleaned from Mongo.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js SEO effect: guards with `if (!overrides) return;` — good, prevents flash of TEST title during initial null state.
App.js theme effect uses document.documentElement.style.setProperty for --g-navy/--g-emerald/--g-gold — correct approach for Tailwind arbitrary values like text-[var(--g-navy)].
sharedDefaults.sections has 11 entries (hero not included since hero is always rendered above the ordered map) — matches spec 'hero always on top'.
editorFields.SectionsField renders eye/up/down with proper disabled state on boundaries — good UX.
Consider: theme color picker only lets user set navy/emerald/gold — if user picks poor contrast, hero title becomes unreadable. Optional: add reset-to-default per-color button next to hex input.
Minor: App.js sets favicon via link[rel='icon'] but does not set link[rel='apple-touch-icon'] — mobile share may still use old asset. Low priority.
sharedDefaults.ogImage defaults to a relative path '/hero-bg-light.webp'; App.js correctly prepends origin when not starting with 'http' — good.
Navbar/Footer use `logo || DEFAULT_LOGO` — safe fallback when shared.logo cleared.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (8/8 scenarios: rename+title ID/EN, SEO CMS, theme navy CSS var + hero color, sections order+hide, footer keys, logo navbar+footer, join form regression, reset defaults)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily created content overrides during testing; all restored/Reset. Created 1 TEST_ contact via join form and deleted afterwards (total 4 TEST_ contacts removed from mongo including any leftovers from previous iterations).
